An application's own page

Its words, its layout and its look are its own. It asks its bootstrap server from an address of its own, and places two of the kit's widgets: the model's progress, in a container docked to the bottom edge of the window, and Bench, in the box below.

Served, for instance, by python -m http.server 7867 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory llm-bootstrap-client, and opened at http://127.0.0.1:7867/example/; the bootstrap server is started with --allow-origin http://127.0.0.1:7867.
